visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown and white Corgi wearing a black collar stands in a field of tall green grass, barking with its mouth wide open. A very worn, torn, and fuzzy green tennis ball lies in the foreground on the dry soil and grass. (2) A person's hand enters from the right side of the frame, reaching down to touch the damaged tennis ball. The hand has light skin and appears to be picking it up. (3) The hand holds the tennis ball up to the Corgi's face. The dog pants happily with its tongue out, its eyes fixed on the ball with an expression of high arousal and excitement. The background consists of a bright green field and distant trees under a cloudy sky. (4) A close-up shot captures the Corgi's face as it smiles and looks directly toward the camera or the hand, with its ears perked up. (5) The hand tosses the ball into the high grass. The Corgi immediately turns and runs into the thick vegetation, its body partially submerged as it begins to sniff and search for the toy.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document a joyful moment with a pet Corgi while narrating the owner's decision to prioritize the dog's mental happiness over strict physical restrictions regarding its joints. The video uses the dog's excited reaction to the ball as evidence of its improved mood.
